message.content:
Berlin is **9 hours ahead** of Los Angeles.  
(When both cities are observing daylight‑saving time—Berlin UTC+2, Los Angeles UTC–7—the offset is 9 hours.)
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What is the time difference between Los Angeles and Berlin?" They want the time difference. We need to consider daylight saving changes. Los Angeles is in Pacific Time (PT), which is UTC-8 standard, UTC-7 DST. Berlin is Central European Time (CET) UTC+1 standard, UTC+2 DST. So difference: Standard: Berlin is 9 hours ahead of LA. During DST: LA is UTC-7, Berlin UTC+2, difference 9 hours again? Wait: Let's compute: Standard: LA UTC-8, Berlin UTC+1 => difference 9 hours. DST: LA UTC-7, Berlin UTC+2 => difference 9 hours. So always 9 hours difference. But if one is on DST and other not? Actually both observe DST but at different times. There might be periods where difference is 8 or 10 hours. For example, when LA is on DST (UTC-7) and Berlin is on standard (UTC+1) difference 8 hours. When LA is on standard (UTC-8) and Berlin on DST (UTC+2) difference 10 hours. So the difference can vary between 8, 9, 10 hours depending on dates. The question likely expects the current difference. As of now (October 26, 2026). In 2026, DST ends in US early November, ends in Europe late October. So currently (Oct 26) Berlin is still on DST (UTC+2) until end of Oct. LA is still on DST until early Nov. So difference: LA UTC-7, Berlin UTC+2 => 9 hours difference. So answer: Berlin is 9 hours ahead of Los Angeles. Provide explanation. No function needed.
